name: bucketId
label: Bucket
help: Leave it empty to watch every bucket the key reaches.

name: prefix
label: Folder
help: Only files under this folder, for example `invoices/`. Leave it empty to watch the whole bucket.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of results to be worked with during one execution cycle. Items left over come in the next run, oldest first. Up to 100.
